name: gentle-replies
description: Companion to the Reply shape rule: a quiet check under each long reply when a call, a changed file or a failed command is missing, /calm to reshape the last long reply, and /gentle for daily numbers and an off switch.

check.title: Check each reply
check.description: Under a reply, one quiet line when something looks off: a long reply without the shape, a question outside Your call, a changed file the reply doesn't name, or a failed command it doesn't mention. Nothing shows when all is fine.

longWords.title: A reply this many words or longer should use the shape
longWords.description: Shorter replies stay plain and are only checked for changed files and failed commands.
